_comment: Reference overlay for the proactive runtime. Copy this to <state_dir>/proactive_config.json (defaults to app/storage/proactive/proactive_config.json) and remove any keys you don't want to override — every path returns its in-code default when the overlay is silent. Discover the live catalogue at any time via POST /proactive/config (returns the overrides + the list of known paths the modules consult).

optimization._comment: Tuning knobs for the four built-in Optimization strategies (tighten_governor, prune_quarantine, relax_constitution, llm_propose). Defaults below match the in-code constants so this file is a no-op if dropped in unchanged.

evolution._comment: Implicit-feedback weighting (0.5 means an implicit signal counts half an explicit thumbs vote) and the recent_thumbs_down validator's weighted veto threshold.

llm_proposer._comment: M5.8-B LLM-backed Evolution proposer. `alias` names the Capability (registered as agent.<alias>); `model.*` configures the auto-registered transport-backed handler when no operator-supplied handler exists. Setting `model.source` to ollama/openai/anthropic picks sensible defaults; override base_url / api_key_env to point at any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic endpoint.

transports._comment: Default scopes applied to a register_transport() call when the caller doesn't pass scopes explicitly. The defaults below are the safest possible (high-stake on both axes) so accidentally-loose transports get gated.

agents._comment: Default scopes per agent kind (local / endpoint / a2a). Same fallback semantics as transports.default_scopes.
